entry.title: OxZygen 0.7.5
entry.summary: # OxZygen v0.7.5 ## What's new - **Mono output option:** in Logic (and other hosts) the plugin can also go on a mono instrument track; the sound is the stereo sound folded to one channel. - **Browse page:** a new BROWSE tab with the categories on the left (All, Voices, Winds, Brass, Strings, Bells, Synth, Air) and that category's presets on the right. Tap a preset to load it; the loaded one is outlined, and ▲ ▼ turn the pages of a long list. - **Preset name on the main page:** the preset's name

entry.title: OxZygen 0.7.4
entry.summary: **What's new in 0.7.4:** the FX page's Q-Links follow its panels again. Each press of the Q-Link button moves to the next panel: Reverb (Size, Decay, Mix), Delay (Time, Feedback, Mix), Drive / Tuning (Amount, Tone, Mix, A4 Tune), Sub / Output (Level, Tune, Drop, Output). **OXZYGEN 0.7.4**: a dark, cinematic instrument for MPC standalone: choirs, vowels and sung "doo"s, flutes, reeds, brass, atmospheric strings, bells, Juno-style synths, wind and textures, with a CRT crystal-ball orb that reacts
